claim: Treat a pinned, evidenced generation as a virtual version: keep each generation immutable with its own evidence, name the live one with a single reviewed active pointer, let consumers declare a generation or follow the active one, and make rollback a move between generations instead of a repository revert or a package downgrade; always state the fidelity (declared, verified-installed or reproduced) because pins decide only what a fresh install gets and an installed environment keeps its packages until reinstalled.

decisions.notes: Operator insight after the M1 generation-2 merge, modelled on browser compatibility modes (per-site mode selection, a default when nothing is declared, emulation fidelity levels, retirement of old modes). Design: virtual-versioning generations design note. Convention: .agent/references/graduation-ceremony-mutation-approvals.md.
